provider: Microsoft Edge online speech via edge-tts 7.2.8
status: Audio recordings ready; matching dealer lip-sync videos are pending. These files do not replace the active game commentary.

opening.transcript: Hello players! One Day Dragon Tiger mein welcome. Apni first bet choose kijiye. Dragon ka card khulte hi second chance milega.
opening.speech: Hello players! One Day Dragon Tiger में welcome. अपनी first bet choose कीजिए. Dragon का card खुलते ही second chance मिलेगा.

ace.transcript: Dragon pe Ace hai. Tiger ka higher card wins, aur Ace aaye toh tie. Second bet se pehle new odds check kijiye.
ace.speech: Dragon पे Ace है. Tiger का higher card wins, और Ace आए तो tie. Second bet से पहले new odds check कीजिए.

low.transcript: Dragon ka card low hai. Tiger ke higher card ke chances zyada hain. Second chance ke new odds screen pe check kijiye.
low.speech: Dragon का card low है. Tiger के higher card के chances ज़्यादा हैं. Second chance के new odds screen पे check कीजिए.

seven.transcript: Dragon pe seven hai. Dono sides ke chances equal hain. Tiger pe seven aaya toh odd-even aur low-high bets lose hongi.
seven.speech: Dragon पे seven है. दोनों sides के chances equal हैं. Tiger पे seven आया तो odd-even और low-high bets lose होंगी.

high.transcript: Dragon ka card high hai. Tiger ko jeetne ke liye higher card chahiye. Second bet se pehle updated odds check kijiye.
high.speech: Dragon का card high है. Tiger को जीतने के लिए higher card चाहिए. Second bet से पहले updated odds check कीजिए.

king.transcript: Dragon pe King hai. Tiger pe King aaya toh tie, warna Dragon wins. Second chance ke options screen pe dekhiye.
king.speech: Dragon पे King है. Tiger पे King आया तो tie, वरना Dragon wins. Second chance के options screen पे देखिए.

dragon-wins.transcript: Dragon wins! Dragon ka card higher hai.
dragon-wins.speech: Dragon wins! Dragon का card higher है.

tiger-wins.transcript: Tiger wins! Tiger ka card higher hai.
tiger-wins.speech: Tiger wins! Tiger का card higher है.

tie.transcript: Same rank! Yeh round tie hua hai.
tie.speech: Same rank! ये round tie हुआ है.
